workload: Real System, Display, Hotkeys and About canvases; first visit plus two repeated click rounds; map opening and reopening; isolated preferences; read-only login status.
measurementNotes: UI workloads ran serially without compiler, core tests, profiling or another HUD fixture.
Normal opening follows completed source/program preparation; cold-source runs bypass that preparation. These are fresh processes, not flushed OS/driver/disk caches.
Run-loop gaps use a 10 ms probe and include deferred tab work. They are not click-to-complete latency or display FPS.
CPU is process CPU as a percent of one core; excludes WindowServer. Short closed samples include heap cleanup.

Cold-source fixture status text could remain blank because async status was not republished after settling. The first-map cold-opening measurement does not render that Settings row. Cold tab-round metrics are not used for conclusions.

The committed fixture adds a status republish immediately before timing; timing and verification binaries used the preceding fixture captured by measuredFixtureSHA256. No production sources changed after build.
